sloka: देव जानाति न ह्येष बलमात्मनि मारुतिः ।ऋषिशापाहृतबलस्तदैष कपिसत्तमः ।। ७.३६.४३ ॥
transliteration: deva jānāti na hyeṣa balamātmani mārutiḥ ।ṛṣiśāpāhṛtabalastadaiṣa kapisattamaḥ ।। 7.36.43 ॥

translations.english: O Lord, indeed, this son of Maruta (Hanuman) does not know his own strength, because he is the best of monkeys whose power was taken away by a sage's curse.
